title: Appeal 24388: garage converted to office within 6 inches and 12 inches of two property lines (Table 302, one-hour walls)
jurisdiction: City of Portland, Oregon (USA), Bureau of Development Services Administrative Appeal Board; non-Alberta comparative record

facts.text: Appeal item: the converted garage is 6 inches from the south property line and 12 inches from the west; the request asks for an alternate to increase the wall to one-hour fire rating.
Proposal: two layers of 5/8-inch gypsum on the interior garage wall up to the roof sheathing.

Decision: alternate one-hour assembly for the south and west walls is granted provided Type X on the interior continuous to the top plate, blocking, no openings within 3 feet, a 5/8-inch roof-underside layer, and no built elements or stormwater crossing the line.
